cohort: Patients admitted to the Department of Obstet and Gynae, Peoples Medical College Hospital (PMCH) Nawabshah from January 2019 to November 2021 who presented with pyrexia/sepsis within 30 days of delivery.
finding: Puerperal sepsis after Caesarean delivery was most common in middle-aged, mostly un-booked, females, and the most common complication was peritonitis.
